# Parity Requirements Checklist: Subagent Screen Parity

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality validation ("unit tests for English") for the subagent screen parity feature — tests whether the 017 requirements corpus (spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, quickstart.md, contracts/ui-parity-contract.md) is complete, clear, consistent, and measurable. This checklist does NOT test implementation behavior.
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: specs/017-please-modify-joey/spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are non-functional requirements (rendering performance non-degradation, input latency) given an explicit ID'd section in spec.md rather than existing only as prose assumptions? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for terminals without clipboard support (OSC52 unavailable) when the FR-006 copy action is invoked? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 - Does FR-011 enumerate a closed list of "all spawn surfaces" (delegate_task, OMO Atlas, /hypercode, dispatch_batch) and state how surfaces added in the future are handled? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 - Does the spec define search behavior for the no-match case and for wrap-around/reaching the end within a pane, beyond the match indicator? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements specified for terminal/pane resize while the focused subagent view is active? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the minimum terminal geometry (≥96 columns, currently only in quickstart.md) stated as a normative requirement in spec.md? [Completeness, Gap, quickstart.md]

### 2026-08-24 — T033 cross-manager child-id collision eliminated at source

- **Problem**: the `/hypercode` surface (engine.rs `hypercode_context_for_agent`) builds a SEPARATE `SubagentManager` from the agent's delegate_task manager; each manager minted child ids from its own counter starting at 1, so a hypercode child id could equal a surviving delegate pane's child_id, and the TUI routes wrapped events by FIRST-MATCH on child_id → event cross-contamination between panes through the process-global tap (funnel audit, subagent_panes.rs T026 section).
- **Approach (1) — process-global id counter**: `manager.rs` now allocates ALL child ids from one `static NEXT_CHILD_ID: AtomicU64` (module-private, no public API change). Pre-checks confirmed no test pins exact manager-minted ids (orchestration tests assert unique/monotonic/≥1 — all preserved; joey-tui tests hand-construct events with synthetic ids). Batch dispatch still pre-allocates ids in deterministic dispatch order: `dispatch_single_with_overrides` gained a `pub(crate) allocated_id` parameter so the wave's child managers receive the parent-minted id rather than racing the global counter — per-manager monotonicity in spawn order is unchanged.
- **Files**: `crates/joey-orchestration/src/manager.rs` (counter + parameter, internal/additive); `crates/joey-orchestration/tests/parallel_tap.rs` (new regression); `crates/joey-tui/tests/subagent_panes.rs` (new T033 test + audit comments refreshed from "open finding" to "resolved at source"; the synthetic duplicate-id first-match pin kept as an App-level contract — joey-tui src untouched).
- **Tests**: `parallel_tap.rs::child_ids_disjoint_across_concurrent_managers` (two managers dispatched CONCURRENTLY via `tokio::join!`, asserts disjoint spawn-id sets through both taps + per-manager unique/monotonic/≥1); `subagent_panes.rs::t033_hypercode_child_never_reuses_delegate_panes_child_id` (delegate pane + later hypercode pane coexist, zero event/lifecycle cross-routing).
- **Verification** (isolated `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/t033`): `cargo test -p joey-orchestration` 44 passed / 0 failed (baseline 43 + 1 new); `cargo test -p joey-tui --test subagent_panes` 44 passed / 0 failed (baseline 43 + 1 new). engine.rs NOT modified → joey-cli suite not required.

### 2026-08-24 — Phase 10 Convergence (T032–T038)

Implementation record for the /speckit-converge gap-closure wave. 25 new
tests landed (24 in joey-tui, 1 in joey-orchestration); joey-tui crate
total is now **395**, joey-orchestration **44**. All test names below were
cross-checked against the actual files.

- **T032 — reasoning flush on completion/failure**: the `SubagentComplete`
  and `SubagentFailed` arms of `App::apply` (crates/joey-tui/src/state.rs)
  flush the pane's pending `streaming_reasoning` before committing the
  final assistant/error item, so a child ending without a trailing
  AssistantMessage/ToolStart still commits its final Reasoning item and the
  pane reasoning panel stops rendering "live". Tests (inline, state.rs):
  `subagent_complete_flushes_pending_pane_reasoning`,
  `subagent_failed_flushes_pending_pane_reasoning`.
- **T033 — process-global child-id counter**: see the dedicated entry
  above (same date). Tests:
  `parallel_tap.rs::child_ids_disjoint_across_concurrent_managers`
  (joey-orchestration) and
  `subagent_panes.rs::t033_hypercode_child_never_reuses_delegate_panes_child_id`
  (joey-tui).
- **T034 — fully pane-aware reasoning panel**: per-pane reasoning
  expansion/view/timer state on `SubagentPane`; click/Esc retargeting to
  the focused pane (the pane click path no longer toggles MAIN reasoning
  state); `thought_duration` stamped on pane Reasoning flushes
  (`pane_flush_reasoning`, state.rs) so committed items render identically
  to the orchestrator screen. Tests (9): app.rs
  `click_on_pane_reasoning_panel_toggles_pane_expansion`,
  `esc_collapses_pane_expanded_reasoning`,
  `pane_expanded_reasoning_freeze_and_repin_semantics`,

  pane_maximized_parity.rs
  `pane_reasoning_panel_title_and_expansion_match_main`.
- **T035 — shared stats-page helpers**: both stats pages now drive ONE
  composed renderer — `render_stats_page_composed` + `StatsPageData`
  (crates/joey-tui/src/widgets.rs) — with `draw_stats_page` (main) a thin

#### Full workspace gate (T038 attempt, 2026-08-24) — FAILED

Isolated `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/t038-gate`, sequential single cargo
invocations (repo convention; a concurrent joey session shares the repo).

- **Build**: `cargo build --workspace` — **PASS** (dev profile, 37.87s;
  warnings only, all pre-existing dead-code/unused-import class).
- **Test attempt 1**: `cargo test --workspace` — **FAILED** at the joey-cli
  bin target (243 passed / 1 failed), so crates ordered after joey-cli did
  not run and no workspace sum exists. Crates that did run: joey-agent-core
  180/0, joey-browser 42/0 + 15/0. Verbatim excerpt:

  ```
  test llm_selector::tests::candidate_pool_fetch_targets_hud_via_copilot_wire ... FAILED
  ---- llm_selector::tests::candidate_pool_fetch_targets_hud_via_copilot_wire stdout ----
  thread 'llm_selector::tests::candidate_pool_fetch_targets_hud_via_copilot_wire' (1821741) panicked at crates/joey-cli/src/llm_selector.rs:737:9:
  assertion failed: pool.is_empty()
  ...
  test result: FAILED. 243 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 2.52s
  error: test failed, to rerun pass `-p joey-cli --bin joey`
  ```

- **Test attempt 2** (fresh full re-run): **FAILED identically** — same

- **Flake characterization** (same class as the T030 `CATALOG_CACHE`
  incident, not yet fixed on this path): solo
  `cargo test -p joey-cli --bin joey` passes **244/244 in 4/4 consecutive
  runs** (~3s each); direct execution of the test binary fails **3 of 8**
  runs (~23s each — real network fetches occur). Mechanism:
  `fetch_candidate_pool("ai-usage-hud")` →
  `joey_providers::copilot::fetch_model_catalog` serves from the
  process-global `CATALOG_CACHE` (60s TTL,
  crates/joey-providers/src/copilot.rs:658) before touching the network;
  the victim test pins `AI_USAGE_HUD_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1` and
  asserts the connection-refused empty pool, but when a concurrently
  scheduled test in the same binary successfully warms the cache against
  this machine's LIVE copilot-wire proxy at 127.0.0.1:8317 (any test that
  constructs a copilot-wire client consults the catalog — see the
  `fetch_model_catalog` doc comment), the victim observes the seeded
  non-empty pool. The `TestEnvGuard` env scrub cannot fix this — the
  pollution is cache-side, not env-side. **Not caused by Phase 10**: no
  joey-cli or joey-providers file is modified by the wave (git status
  confirms).
- **Scoped Phase 10 crates (same isolated dir, green)**:
  `cargo test -p joey-tui` → **395 passed / 0 failed** (259 lib + 136

- **Verdict**: per the T038 acceptance rule, a red gate means **T038 is NOT
